history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark hair and sunglasses stands on a wooden plank extending over crystal-clear turquoise water. He is wearing a black hoodie and black shorts, with dark clogs on his feet. His right hand is raised, touching his hair. The background features a dramatic coastline with lush green cliffs and the vast blue ocean under a bright, partly cloudy sky. The water is so transparent that the seabed is visible in places. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting a sunny day, creating a vibrant and refreshing color palette dominated by blues and greens. The mood is adventurous and serene, capturing a moment of contemplation before a potential dive or simply enjoying the view. The style is realistic, with a focus on natural beauty and a sense of freedom.
